params.body:
- A vehicle type without offer is no longer rendered (a greyed button that does nothing is noise); with one type left the row disappears. Desktop and phone.
- Phone: the remaining types are wrapping chips with icon and name; the 'only the active one shows its name' rule from #149 clipped the name and is gone.
- Phone toolbar: Filters and the sort select are two equal controls (42px, 14px medium, plain text with a chevron); the funnel icon is dropped there so the pair reads as one.
params.title: Stocklist: hide empty vehicle types, equal toolbar controls on phones
